title: Crispy Sesame Spring Rolls
description: A Chinese-inspired snack featuring crunchy sesame spring rolls served warm. Enjoy the perfect balance of textures and flavors.
instructions: 1. In a small bowl, mix together sesame oil and sesame seeds. Set aside.
2. Cut the spring roll wrappers into quarters.
3. In a large pan or wok, heat 1/4 inch of vegetable oil over medium-high heat.
4. When the oil is hot, add a few spring roll wrappers to the pan and fry until crispy, about 2-3 minutes.
5. Remove the fried spring rolls from the oil and place them on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
6. Repeat the frying process with the remaining spring roll wrappers.
7. In a separate pan, heat a small amount of oil over medium heat.
8. Add the shredded carrots, cabbage, zucchini, and bean sprouts to the pan and cook until the vegetables are tender.
9. Add the cooked vegetables to the fried spring rolls and mix well.
10. Serve the crispy sesame spring rolls warm, garnished with additional sesame seeds if desired.
